who_html: Mariana Tek describes itself as software for boutique fitness studios that want a high-end, branded customer experience, from single-location studios to global brands and franchises. Its customers run group classes including pilates (Lagree, Megaformer and mat), yoga, barre, indoor cycling, HIIT and boxing. Mariana Tek says typical onboarding takes five to eight weeks with dedicated onboarding specialists and a demo environment. Every plan includes multi-location management, unlimited classes and instructors, intro offers, packs and memberships, CRM, reporting, kiosk check-in, digital waivers and transactional emails.
compare_html: Mindbody publishes an entry price (from $79/mo per location) and lists studios on its consumer app, with a 20% fee (capped at $30) on new clients' first app purchase. Mariana Tek publishes no prices and focuses on your own branded app instead of a marketplace. Zen Planner (from $99/mo) and Gymdesk (from $75/mo) publish prices and suit membership gyms and martial arts schools; Mariana Tek is aimed at boutique class studios with features like pick-a-spot floor plans for reformers and bikes. See also yoga studio tools and dance and yoga studio software compared.

who_html: Studio Helper describes itself as studio management software for music studios, yoga studios, dance studios, martial arts dojos and other teaching studios (music, dance, fitness, sports, martial arts). The testimonials on its homepage come mostly from music teaching businesses, including a studio with 5 teachers and more than 100 students. Features it lists: a real-time calendar for students, teachers and staff with room and teacher scheduling, reminders and attendance tracking; online invoicing and payments; payroll, expense and inventory tracking; built-in reports for key metrics and tax returns; permissions per role; student skill updates with parent alerts; mass email messaging; to-do assignments; and embedding into your existing website to show availability.
compare_html: For a solo music teacher, flat-priced tools cost less on paper: Duet ($9/mo), My Music Staff ($16.95/mo plus $4.95 per extra teacher) and Fons ($19.95/mo). At Studio Helper's published rate, 40 students works out to $60/mo and 100 students to $75/mo. Teach 'n Go is $79/mo for up to 100 live students, so the two are close for a mid-size multi-teacher studio; Studio Helper adds payroll, expense and inventory tracking. mySymphony charges $0.25 per booked lesson rather than per student.
